title: Grateful Dead Live at Rochester Community War Memorial on 1973-03-30

ai_review.summary: Half‑SBD (matrix) recording offers a clean, download‑worthy second half with a smoking Truckin' > Eyes jam, though the early audience portion is muddy.
ai_review.review: The show shines in its second set – concise Play In The Band, a groovy China Rider transition and an epic Truckin' → Eyes of the World jam that showcase the band’s hot ’73 energy. Recording-wise the soundboard feed from Playin’ onward is crisp and enjoyable, while the preceding audience tape suffers from hum and muddiness but remains listenable for completists.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for musical performance (standout jams, hot keys, uplifting vibe) outweighs the mixed recording quality of the early audience portion.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard feed from Playin' onward is clean and clear; earlier audience tape is sketchy, muddy, with a hum but still marginally listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second half with concise PITB, smooth transitions (China Rider jam) and a powerful Truckin' jam; first set solid but marred by poor audience recording.

band_member_comments.Keys: Hot 73 keyboard work highlighted, especially Keith's interesting piano during the Truckin' jam.
